phrases: a blinking warning light（闪烁的警示灯）

example.english: I blinked when the camera flashed.
example.chinese: 相机闪光时，我眨了下眼。

usageNote: 主语是人时常表示眨眼。The light on the charger is blinking. 表示充电器上的指示灯在闪。

meaning: 一票货件 / 一批托运的货物
phrases: a consignment of spare parts（一批托运的备件）
track a consignment（追踪一票货件）

example.english: Consignment received at the PostNL Acceptance Centre
example.chinese: PostNL 收寄中心已收到这票货件。
example.source: 用户提供的 PostNL 物流状态

usageNote: 物流状态常用简写。补成完整句子可以说 The consignment has been received at the PostNL Acceptance Centre.
